faq: Do I need to know code to manage this later?
No. Collections are edited in the Wix content manager, like a spreadsheet. We show you how to add and edit records, and the code is commented in case a developer needs to read it.
Does Velo work on every Wix site?
Velo works on Wix and Wix Studio sites, with a Premium plan needed for publishing. We check your plan and editor first and tell you plainly if something is not supported, before we start.
Can you import my existing spreadsheet?
Yes. Send a CSV or Google Sheet and we map the columns to collection fields, clean the data and import it. We check for duplicates and missing values first and send you a short list.
Is it safe to store customer data in a collection?

We set permissions so only the right people can read or write each collection, and we avoid storing sensitive data like payment details. Wix handles the hosting, and you decide the privacy wording that applies to you.

desc:
Wix Velo and CMS development makes your site run on real data: collections, dynamic pages, search and custom code. Ecom Swift LLC builds the database and the pages that use it inside your own Wix site.

## What are Wix CMS and Velo?

Wix CMS is the content management system inside Wix. It stores information in collections, which work like tables with fields for text, numbers, images, dates and references to other items. Velo is Wix's development platform, which adds JavaScript code, backend functions and database tools to the editor.

Together they let one page template display many items. A single dynamic page can show every property, recipe, course or team member in a collection, filled with that item's own data.

## Why use a collection instead of building each page by hand?

Building fifty similar pages by hand means fifty places to make a mistake and fifty edits when something changes. A collection holds each item once. When a price or description changes, you edit one record and every page that uses it updates.

Collections also make features possible that static pages cannot offer: searching and filtering a list, saving form entries, showing content only to logged-in members and sending an email when a record is added. If your site holds more than a handful of similar items, a collection is usually the cleaner approach.

## How a data-driven site affects visitors and your team

Visitors find items faster. A list page with search and filters lets a person narrow a catalog by category or location, instead of scrolling through pages. Member-only content gives clients or students a private area, and a form that saves entries means requests are stored in one place instead of scattered across inboxes.

For your team the gain is time and consistency. Records are added through a simple form or imported from a spreadsheet, and the design always stays the same. Cost, speed and quality improve because the structure does the repeating work, though the benefit depends on how much data you actually manage.

## What a good Wix CMS and Velo build includes

- Collections designed with the right field types for each kind of information.
- Reference fields that link items, such as products to categories.
- A dynamic item page designed once and filled from the collection.
- A list page with a repeater or table that shows items in a clean layout.
- Search and filter controls that work on the list.
- Forms that save entries to a collection with validation.
- Permissions that decide who can view, add or edit records.
- Member-only pages and content where needed.
- Velo code for custom logic, with comments and developer notes.
- Data imported from a sheet or CSV, and a guide for adding records later.

## What we do

We begin by mapping the information you handle: what an item is, which details it has and how items relate. We then create the collections in your Wix site, design the dynamic and list pages, and add records. Once the structure works, we write the Velo code, set permissions and test everything with sample records.

The Basic package builds one collection with a dynamic page and a list. The Standard package covers up to three collections with search, filters, a saving form, imported records and edit permissions. The Premium package builds a full data-driven section with several linked collections, member-only content, custom code, email on new entries and a CSV import. Extra collections and imports are available as add-ons.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Sketch your data on paper before building anything.
- Use one record per real item.
- Keep field names clear and consistent.
- Clean your spreadsheet before import.
- Set permissions as tightly as the content allows.

**Avoid:**
- Storing sensitive personal data without a clear reason.
- Duplicating the same information in several collections.
- Editing live records while an import is running.
- Adding code for features Wix already provides natively.
- Sharing passwords, which we never need.

## Who this service is for

- A directory, listing or portfolio site with many items of the same type.
- A school, club or membership business that needs content visible only after login.
- A business that wants an online form to save requests into a managed database.
- An owner with a spreadsheet of products, events or people who wants it turned into pages.

## What we need from you

Send a short description of what the site should do, a sample of your data or spreadsheet, and examples of pages you like. Add us as a collaborator or developer user in your Wix account, so we never need your password. Velo must be enabled on the site, and we can turn it on during setup. We build it, test it with sample records and explain how your team adds data later.
